### Caleb’s Successes
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/calebs-successes
Passage: Joshua 15:13-19
Points:
- God sovereignly guided Joshua to allot Hebron to Caleb, honoring his unwavering faithfulness.
- Relying on the Lord's presence, Caleb successfully drove the Anakite giants from the region.
- Demonstrating zeal for his tribe's welfare, Caleb encouraged others to help recapture the city of Debir.
- Othniel seized the challenge, foreshadowing his later role as a judge delivering Israel.
- Caleb showed generous fatherly love by granting Acsah's request for upper and lower springs in an arid land.
- Christians are challenged to look beyond selfish interests and take bold risks for God's glory.
